name: casting.gsl

captions.text:
A mining drill bit: tungsten carbide inserts
brazed to a cast steel body
AI analyzes the body and develops a casting strategy
We orient the body in the direction of the pour
A sprue and pouring cup are added to supply the molten steel
Gates join the part to the sprue to complete the branch
We simulate the plastic deformation of the casting process and invert it
The branch is patterned around the sprue, forming a tree
The tree is embossed with its work order on top and alloy on the sides
It is 3D printed as a pattern: a thin skin over a load bearing lattice
The pattern is dipped in ceramic, coat after coat, to build a shell
In the furnace, the pattern sublimates and the shell is fired
~1,600°C Molten steel fills the hot shell
The steel cools and shrinks to the warp-corrected size
The parts are sawn from the tree and their gates ground or machined off
Shot peening evens and hardens the surface
Finally, the carbide teeth are brazed on
